payload.definition: A single-file model format used by llama.cpp. One file contains everything needed to run inference.
Video RAM — the memory on your GPU. Models load here for fast inference. More VRAM = bigger models.
A named job that needs a model. 'Brain' is a slot. 'Voice' is a slot. Assign a model to a slot to enable that ability.
Compressing model weights to use less memory. Q4 = 4-bit (smallest), Q8 = 8-bit, F16 = 16-bit (full precision).
A model that converts text into a vector (list of numbers). Similar texts produce similar vectors, enabling semantic search.
A model that scores how relevant a document is to a query. Runs after the embedder to refine search results.
Running a model to get a response. When the AI 'thinks' and produces text, that's inference.
How much text a model can read at once. Measured in tokens (roughly 1 token = 0.75 words). 4K tokens ~ 3,000 words.
